summary: Split the 999-line apps/app/tests/App.test.ts into five semantically named integration test files under apps/app/tests/app/, each at most 267 lines, with shared setup/cleanup and a renderApp helper in tests/support/app.ts. All 34 original test bodies were preserved byte-for-byte, prettier, svelte-check, and the full app vitest suite (37 files, 170 tests) all passed.
decisions: Partition tests into five integration files by domain: shell, workspace-navigation, workspace-configuration-and-threads, settings-and-workspace-picker, conversation.

Centralize shared beforeEach/afterEach setup (FakeAgentClient-based render, toasts cleanup, innerWidth reset) and the renderApp() helper in apps/app/tests/support/app.ts rather than duplicating per file.
Keep each integration file ≤300 LOC (largest is 267 lines) to satisfy the file-length constraint.
Verify preservation by extracting test bodies via a deterministic split on '\n\tit(' and diffing against the pre-split source, treating trailing-newline differences as equivalent.
Leave package.json and the agent-server test split work untouched even though they appeared in git status, because the task scope was only the App.test.ts split.
Do not commit; leave changes staged in the working tree.
errors: First Python extraction attempt failed with ValueError: substring not found because the indexing expression used a false ternary that referenced '\tdescribe'; fixed by removing the ternary and using s.index("describe('application shell'") directly.

Initial byte-equality assertion flagged test 10 as changed, but the diff showed only a trailing-newline difference per test; verification was re-run with .rstrip() and confirmed all 34 test bodies unchanged apart from EOF newlines.
